pkgmetadata.longdescription: CPU-only build of llama.cpp (same upstream as sci-misc/llama-cpp), with CUDA/ROCm/Vulkan/OpenCL/SYCL hard-disabled. Exists to avoid the ~358 MiB CUDA-context VRAM overhead a CUDA-built llama-server carries even at runtime -ngl 0. Installed under /opt/llama-cpp-cpu with only llama-server symlinked system-wide as /usr/bin/llama-cpu, so it coexists with sci-misc/llama-cpp without any file collision.
